UpdateContactRequest.description: Changes to a contact, same rules as create. Leave a field out to keep it, send null to clear it (`first_name` and `last_name` can't be cleared).

UpdateCropRequest.description: Crop changes; leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateCurrencyRequest.description: Changes to a currency. Leave a field out to keep it; send null to clear it.

UpdateCustomStatusRequest.description: Changes to a custom status. Domain and `archived` can't change here; leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateCustomTypeRequest.description: Changes to a custom type. The domain can't change; `properties` follows the same per-domain rules as create. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateDealRequest.description: Changes to a deal. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateEndpointRequest.description: Changes to an endpoint. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateFlowSceneRequest.description: PUT body: any of the three; omitted ones keep the saved value (else the default).

oneOf.description: Required on a new custom scene. Replaces the whole component list.

UpdateHourlyRateRequest.description: Changes to an hourly rate. Both prices are always required; leave another field out to keep it, send null to clear it (`title` and `description` can't be null).

UpdateLotRequest.description: Changes to a lot. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdateOrderRequest.description: Changes to an order. Leave a field out to keep it.

UpdatePipelineRequest.description: Changes to a pipeline. Leave a field out to keep it.

sorting.description: `a-z`, `z-a` or `pos`; blank keeps the stored one.

UpdateSalesGroupRequest.description: Changes to a sales group. `name` is always required; leave another field out to keep it, send null to clear it.

active.description: false pauses (`paused_reason` `user`), true resumes from the next slot.

UpdateSettingsRequest.description: Sections to save, keyed by section name. Each sent section is validated and replaces the stored one; unknown sections and keys are dropped. Send a credential's mask back to keep it.

UpdateShipmentMethodRequest.description: Changes to a shipment method. Both price impacts and `countries` are always required (`countries` may be empty); leave another field out to keep it.

countries.description: Up to 300 rows `{name?, country? (ISO alpha-2), price? (>= 0), lead_time_hours? (>= 0)}`.

UpdateStatusRequest.description: Changes to a column. Leave a field out to keep it; `deal_pipeline_id` is required. The custom status never changes.

UpdateTeamRequest.description: Changes to a team. Leave a field out to keep it; send null `meta` to clear it.

UpdateTillUserRequest.description: Changes to a till user. A new PIN clears a lock; inactive users can't log in and their sessions end.

UpdateVatGroupRequest.description: Changes to a VAT group. `name` and `vat_amount` are always required; leave another field out to keep it, send null to clear it.

UpdateVillageRequest.description: Village changes; leave a field out to keep it, send null to clear a coordinate.

UploadForm.description: Upload as a multipart form: one file part `upload` (at most 10 MB) plus these text parts; any other part is refused.

public.description: Required; files are always stored private.

UploadInput.description: Upload reservation holds quota without storing file bytes or names.

UploadRequest.description: Upload as JSON: the file base64-encoded. At most 10 MB once decoded.

public.description: Required; files are always stored private.

UserDetail.description: A member as seen from one workspace: only that workspace's permissions and teams.

UserEmailResource.description: A user shown inside another record (team member, inviter, ...).

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

UserIdsRequest.description: Users to add to or remove from the team.

UserResource.description: A user with their permissions, teams and pending invites.

color.description: Display color; not stored yet, always null.

ValidationErrorBody.description: Validation failed. `errors` maps each field to its messages.

VariantList.description: List response: every variant, not paged.

VariantOption.description: One option value of a variant.

VatGroupCreated.description: Create response: the new row's id.

VatGroupResource.description: A VAT rate the workspace can apply; one is the default.

VaultResource.description: A vault and the cash it holds.

VerifyQueueSummary.description:
Records waiting for a second pair of eyes (`unverified` or `pending`), per kind, as the
caller's verify lists hold them.

harvest_reports.description: Every outstanding harvest figure, superseded ones included (as the list).

VillageDataQualityResource.description: How complete one village's records are (live rows only).

cycles_with_estimate.description: Cycles with a current expected harvest figure.

VillageEnergyResource.description:
RUAHA `v_village_energy` for one village. kW figures are decimal text; capacity fields are
null for a village without a current capacity row.

approved_kw_raw.description: Sum of estimated kW of approved requests.

prospective_kw_raw.description: Sum of estimated kW of submitted and under-review requests.

VillageProductionResource.description: One crop in one harvest month of a village.

cycle_area_ha.description: The SUM OF CYCLE AREAS, not land area: intercropped cycles share a plot.

window_month.description: First day of the harvest month; null for cycles without a harvest window.

oneOf.description: Current capacity; null when the caller is neither a manager nor a member of this village.

VillageSupplyResource.description: Expected, committed and available kg of one crop in one harvest month.

window_month.description: First day of the harvest month; null for cycles without a harvest window.

WarehouseBinRequest.description: Create needs `bin_code`; update keeps fields left out.

meta.description: Sent only when the list was cut at the cap.

WarehouseLocationRequest.description: POST body (create and update): `location` required, `meta` optional.

WarehouseRequest.description: Create or update a warehouse. Update keeps fields left out; null clears them.

custom_sections.description: Custom fields are not supported: an item naming a `section_id` is rejected.

WarehouseResource.description: A warehouse, with its child warehouses and responsible people.

formatted_location.description: One-line address; left out when there is no location.

utilization.description: Occupied bins of the grid, in %; null without a grid.

WarehouseRowRequest.description: Create needs `row_code`, `row_name` and the three sizes; update keeps fields left out.

WarehouseSectionRequest.description: POST body for create and update (`warehouse_id`/`workspace_id` keys are ignored).

WarehouseShelfRequest.description: Create needs `shelf_code` and `shelf_level`; update keeps fields left out.

WebhookDeliveryResource.description: One event sent (or being sent) to an endpoint: its outcome and why it failed.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt failed. URL query strings are cut, since they may carry tokens.

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last answer; null when no answer came.

status.description: `pending` (retrying), `delivered`, or `failed` (gave up after the last attempt).

WebhookEndpointCreated.description: A new endpoint. Store `secret` now: it is never shown again.

secret.description: Standard Webhooks secret: HMAC-SHA256 key is the base64 after `whsec_`.

WebhookEndpointResource.description: Where this workspace's events are POSTed, signed with the endpoint's secret.

WebhookEvent.description: An event an endpoint can subscribe to.

WorkspaceAccount.description: Bank details. Unset values are null.

account_number.description: IBAN; spaces and case are normalized.

WorkspaceAddress.description: Company address. Unset values are null.

house_number.description: Numeric, sent as a string or a number; returned as sent.
Numeric; a string or a number.

WorkspacePermissions.description: Effective permission names in one workspace.

WorkspaceProfile.description: Company profile. Every key is always present; unset values are null.

oneOf.description: Bank details; left out where any member can read the profile.

WorkspaceProfilePatch.description: Company profile changes. Leave a key out to keep it; send null (or a blank string) to clear it. A sent `address` or `account` replaces the stored one.

WorkspaceRecordResource.description: The workspace record with its full company profile.

display_name.description: The profile's `company_name`, or the slug when it has none. Show this.

WorkspaceResource.description: A workspace the user belongs to.

display_name.description: The profile's `company_name`, or the slug when it has none. Show this.

Company profile; left out until one is saved. Bank details (`account`) are never
